liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Jerry flubs a lyric, then compensates with an intense solo ending into Delilah [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-09-27.mtx.tobin.87661.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 181 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Matrix provides a sense of distance and echo resembling the actual concert hall [13]
- **gd1976-09-27.171281.mtx.seamons.ht177.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 182 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Phil is low in Promised Land; sound improves after the band addresses a hum; Jerry's guitar and vocals cut out late in Supplication, returning near the end [2]
- **gd1976-09-27.163759.sony.ecm33.unknown.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 179 min [4]. Said about its sound: New transfer includes U.S. Blues, missing from other sources, and avoids redundant repeats [4]
- **gd1976-09-27.sbd.miller.87664.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 33 [5]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is described as very crisp and clear throughout the recording; Miller's transfer sounds significantly better than previous copies, rated 9.5 out of 10 [8][10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer watched Dark Star recreate the set, praising the upstate New York jam scene [7]
- Second set is top tier, while first set songs are less polished than 1977 [8]
- Reviewer claims this show surpasses the September 25 and 28, 1976 performances [10]
- Second set ranks with the best classic shows the reviewer has ever heard [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-09-27.mtx.tobin.87661.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [1]. Also: Audition 2.0 reassembled tracks, aligned SBD and AUD sources, and adjusted volumes [1]
- **gd1976-09-27.171281.mtx.seamons.ht177.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) May 5,… [2]
- **gd1976-09-27.163759.sony.ecm33.unknown.ebel.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Transfers and edits by Pete Ebel February 19, 2023; source: FOB Sony ECM-33Ps-> Sony TC-152-> Cassette-> DAT [4]. Also: Pete Ebel transferred a new source with less deck pauses and smoother sound [4]
- **gd1976-09-27.sbd.miller.87664.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [5]
